description: Scan the repository structure and key files (README, package/build configs, lint/test configs, main entrypoints) to identify exactly one small maintainability defect; document the exact location (file path + line range/snippet) and propose a concrete fix with rationale.
constraints: Identify exactly one (1) small maintainability defect (no broad refactor).
Only use repository structure + the following file types/targets: README, package/build configs, lint/test configs, main entrypoints.
Fix must be concrete (specific diff-level change) and minimal.
Include a runnable verification step (commands) to confirm the fix.
acceptance_criteria: Provide the defect location as: file path + line range (or exact snippet) that can be verified by opening the file.
Provide a fix as an exact, checkable change (e.g., a patch/diff or explicit before/after blocks) applicable to the identified file(s).
Provide rationale tied to maintainability (e.g., reduces duplication, prevents drift, clarifies entrypoint/config).
Provide verification commands that can be run (e.g., npm test/lint/build, cargo test, pytest, mvn test) and state expected pass/fail outcome before vs after.
All claims are verifiable by running the listed commands and/or grepping the referenced lines/snippet.
allowed_tools: Read file contents (e.g., cat, sed, head/tail) for README, package/build configs, lint/test configs, and main entrypoints
